observations.observation: Ivan работает соло — корпоративные решения (Jenkins, Kubernetes) не предлагать
Автоматизация (скрипт) > разовое ручное действие — Ivan ценит инструменты
systemd user timers more reliable than cron for WSL2 periodic tasks
When model returns semantic field (sentiment, category) — trust and USE it, don't re-derive from summary text
When creating a tool similar to an existing one, read the existing analog FIRST — prevents interface/pattern mismatch bugs
Direct Anthropic API (fetch) is 40x faster than claude --print subprocess for background inference — always prefer API when key available
Persistence through code, not prompts: when data must survive sessions, automatic hooks are the only reliable mechanism — prompt instructions for disk writes are architecturally unsound
Ivan silently ignores stderr in fire-and-forget processes — bugs hide for months; always surface raw output first
When finding one JSON parsing bug in Inference.ts, Ivan audits all 4 dependent tools (TELOSTracker, FailureCapture, WisdomExtractor, IntegrityMaintenance)
